AI Video Generator Free Music 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate videos with free background music from your images or clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB).
- Supports uploading, editing, and exporting 1080p MP4 videos in 1-2 minutes through a cloud GPU pipeline.
- 100 free credits with anonymous sign-in for quick, no-registration access.
- Built-in commands for uploading, downloading, checking credits, and exporting results.
- Automatic session and token management; handles common errors and provides clear user feedback.
- Streamlined workflows for content creators and marketers needing fast, music-backed video generation.
